title: Chassis & CO2 Mount Design Review
reference_notes: Good designs typically show a tapered, smoothly-curved nose (no abrupt frontal area step), symmetric wheel wells cut cleanly through the body, and a rear-mounted cylinder channel sized close to a 16g CO2 cartridge (nominal diameter ~16.3mm, length ~68mm) with a visible retention/seal feature. Weak designs are boxy with a flat front face, have wheel wells that look hand-hacked and asymmetric, or show a cylinder channel with no clear retention method.
